rows.title: Help with our nonprofit project
rows.proposal: The nonprofit needs a live web app that pushes updates to the browser and can be exported as an image. 1) I’ll build a WebSocket-backed API that streams state changes to a React front-end, 2) I’ll add a server-side rendering layer that captures the UI as a PNG for export, and 3) I’ll write Playwright tests to verify real-time behavior and image integrity. I have used Playwright in projects such as the accessibility overhaul of a government portal [web-case-17] and the SaaS billing portal rebuild [web-case-04]. I used WebSockets to provide real-time updates in a logistics tracking system [web-case-03]. I’ll deliver the final product with hand-over documentation for your non-technical team and ensure accessibility for nonprofit users. Next step: let’s schedule a brief call to discuss your data model and export requirements.
answers: I would design a relational schema with a central "events" table capturing timestamped state changes, linked to user and session tables; this allows efficient querying of live data and audit trails while keeping the model simple for a nonprofit team.
